familyAudit.decision: Be and existential there cover basic predication; agreement and dummy subjects need explicit targets.
Plural, mass/count and complex nominal lessons exist; possession needs a separate alternation target.
Articles and quantity are mapped; demonstrative deixis needs explicit coverage.
Personal and reflexive pronouns exist; indefinite, reciprocal and independent possessive forms need separate targets.
Degree and comparison exist; adjective order lacks a distinct unit.
Present, past and aspect contrasts are mapped; irregular forms remain an open lexical inventory.
Future forms and time relations are mapped; reported time belongs to an overlapping family.
Complement selection and multiword verbs are mapped; every lexical governor still needs its own examples.
Infinitive, gerund and participle patterns are mapped; control and meaning preservation must be checked per item.
Obligation, ability and epistemic modality are mapped; one modal may have several readings.
Voice and causatives are mapped; passive feasibility depends on the lexical predicate and intended reading.
Questions and negation are mapped; subject/object question contrast needs an explicit target.
Place, time and dependent prepositions are mapped; selection cannot be inferred from translation alone.
Linking and layered embedding are present; mandative complements require a named target.
Basic and complex relatives are mapped; restrictive status and omitted object pronouns require item-level checks.
Open, remote and counterfactual conditions exist; generic conditions need explicit scope.
Statements, questions and reporting verbs are mapped; source and viewpoint changes remain explicit constraints.
Clefts, fronting and inversion are mapped; discourse equivalence is distinct from propositional equivalence.
Cohesion, register and spoken features are mapped; genre labels do not establish proficiency.
Integration lessons are retained as bundles; they do not replace atomic construction coverage.
Punctuation, capitalisation and apostrophes exist; inflectional spelling needs a separate graphic target.
Basic clauses and the verb bracket are mapped; complement-es needs an explicit target.
Case, number and nominal groups exist; gender assignment and derivation need separate inventories.
Articles, possession and quantity are mapped; demonstratives need explicit reference contrasts.
Personal, indefinite and pronominal adverbs exist; reciprocal and negative-indefinite patterns need explicit scope.
Adjective inflection and comparison exist; adjective government and als/wie contrasts need explicit targets.
Past forms and tense relations are mapped; lexical auxiliary and participle inventories stay extensible.
Futur I is mapped; Futurperfekt is named in the reference but lacks a distinct catalog target.
Verb government and functional-verb patterns exist; infinitive substitution needs a dedicated complex-verb target.
Infinitive and participial constructions are mapped; controller and attachment conditions remain item-specific.
Objective and subjective modal meanings are mapped; evidential source must remain distinguishable.
Event, state, modal passive and alternatives are mapped; replacement forms may add modal meaning.
Questions, negation and scope are mapped; the oral intonation dimension remains required evidence.
Place, time, alternating-case and genitive prepositions are mapped; lexical relations stay open-ended.
Coordinators, subordinators and connector adverbs are mapped with distinct position rules.
Nominative, accusative and dative relatives are explicit; genitive relatives need a distinct target.
Open, remote and past counterfactual structures are mapped; time and modality constrain transformations.
Konjunktiv reporting is mapped; forms and source attribution remain separate review dimensions.
Vorfeld, Mittelfeld and Nachfeld are mapped; alternative orders need contextual focus checks.
Register, cohesion, particles and perspective are mapped; linguistic appropriateness needs situated review.
Integration bundles are preserved without claiming that they cover every subconstruction.
Punctuation and citation syntax exist; separate/compound spelling needs a dedicated graphic target.
